evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies the getblocktemplate RPC cache architecture in BlockTemplateManager.
rationale: Moves getblocktemplate caching state out of process-lifetime static variables into BlockTemplateManager to eliminate raw pointer lifetime issues in multi-node tests and enable direct unit testing. This refactor makes progress on tracking issue #33758 ('Remove remaining global states') and adds compile-time thread-safety annotations, but does not alter template validity or RPC behavior.
